volume_downsample — 3D preprocess op

• 数据种类:voxel → voxel

• 调用:import volops; volops.volume_downsample(vol, factor, mode='mean')(或 ops3d.get("volume_downsample"))

用法

> 该算子的说明尚无译文,以下照原文给出。

Block-pool a `(D, H, W)` volume by an integer *factor* per axis (data 間引き).
